tags.name: dc-button
tags.description:
A button element with variant, size and disabled states.
---


### **Slots:**
 - _default_ - Button label content.

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--dc-button-bg** - Background color, overrides the variant default for all variants. _(default: undefined)_
- **--dc-button-border** - Border color, overrides the variant default for all variants. _(default: undefined)_
- **--dc-button-color** - Text color, overrides the variant default for all variants. _(default: undefined)_
- **--dc-button-bg-hover** - Background color on hover, overrides the variant default for all variants. _(default: undefined)_
- **--dc-button-border-hover** - Border color on hover, overrides the variant default for all variants. _(default: undefined)_
- **--dc-button-focus-ring** - Focus ring color, overrides the variant default for all variants. _(default: undefined)_
- **--dc-button-primary-bg** - Background color for the `primary` variant. _(default: #2563eb)_
- **--dc-button-primary-border** - Border color for the `primary` variant. _(default: #2563eb)_
- **--dc-button-primary-color** - Text color for the `primary` variant. _(default: #fff)_
- **--dc-button-primary-bg-hover** - Background color for the `primary` variant on hover. _(default: #1d4ed8)_
- **--dc-button-primary-border-hover** - Border color for the `primary` variant on hover. _(default: #1d4ed8)_
- **--dc-button-primary-focus-ring** - Focus ring color for the `primary` variant. _(default: #1d4ed8)_
- **--dc-button-secondary-bg** - Background color for the `secondary` variant. _(default: #fff)_
- **--dc-button-secondary-border** - Border color for the `secondary` variant. _(default: #d1d5db)_
- **--dc-button-secondary-color** - Text color for the `secondary` variant. _(default: #111827)_
- **--dc-button-secondary-bg-hover** - Background color for the `secondary` variant on hover. _(default: #f3f4f6)_
- **--dc-button-secondary-border-hover** - Border color for the `secondary` variant on hover. _(default: #d1d5db)_
- **--dc-button-secondary-focus-ring** - Focus ring color for the `secondary` variant. _(default: #6b7280)_
- **--dc-button-danger-bg** - Background color for the `danger` variant. _(default: #dc2626)_
- **--dc-button-danger-border** - Border color for the `danger` variant. _(default: #dc2626)_
- **--dc-button-danger-color** - Text color for the `danger` variant. _(default: #fff)_
- **--dc-button-danger-bg-hover** - Background color for the `danger` variant on hover. _(default: #b91c1c)_
- **--dc-button-danger-border-hover** - Border color for the `danger` variant on hover. _(default: #b91c1c)_
- **--dc-button-danger-focus-ring** - Focus ring color for the `danger` variant. _(default: #b91c1c)_

attributes.name: disabled

tags.name: dc-card
tags.description:
A container with optional header and footer sections that auto-hide when empty.
---


### **Slots:**
 - _default_ - Main card content.
- **header** - Header content, shown above the main content. Hidden when empty.
- **footer** - Footer content, shown below the main content, right-aligned. Hidden when empty.

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--dc-card-border-color** - Border color for the card and its header/footer dividers. _(default: #e5e7eb)_
- **--dc-card-bg** - Background color of the card. _(default: #fff)_

tags.name: dc-close-button
tags.description:
A small round button with an × icon, used to close or clear things.
---


### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--dc-close-button-color** - Icon color. _(default: #6b7280)_
- **--dc-close-button-bg-hover** - Background color on hover. _(default: #f3f4f6)_
- **--dc-close-button-color-hover** - Icon color on hover. _(default: #111827)_
- **--dc-close-button-focus-ring** - Focus ring color. _(default: #6b7280)_
- **--dc-close-button-radius** - Border radius. _(default: 6px)_

tags.name: dc-dialog
tags.description:
A modal dialog built on the native `<dialog>` element.
---


### **Events:**
 - **dc-close** - Fired when the dialog closes, whether via `close()`, the close button, Escape, or a backdrop click.

### **Methods:**
 - **show()** - Opens the dialog modally.
- **close()** - Closes the dialog.

### **Slots:**
 - _default_ - Main dialog content. Scrolls independently when it overflows the dialog's max height.
- **header** - Header content, shown above the main content. Hidden when empty.
- **footer** - Footer content, right-aligned below the main content. Hidden when empty.

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--dc-dialog-bg** - Background color of the dialog. _(default: #fff)_
- **--dc-dialog-backdrop** - Background color of the `::backdrop`. _(default: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5))_

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the dialog is open. Reflects `show()`/`close()`; showing/hiding it modally.

tags.name: dc-input
tags.description:
A text input with a clear button that appears when it has content.
---


### **Events:**
 - **dc-input** - Fired with `{ value }` on every value change, mirroring the native `input` event.
- **dc-change** - Fired with `{ value }` when the change is committed, mirroring the native `change` event.

### **Methods:**
 - **clear()** - Clears the input's value and fires `dc-input`/`dc-change`.
- **focus(options)** - Focuses the input.

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--dc-input-bg** - Background color. _(default: #fff)_
- **--dc-input-border** - Border color. _(default: #d1d5db)_
- **--dc-input-border-hover** - Border color on hover. _(default: #9ca3af)_
- **--dc-input-border-focus** - Border color when focused. _(default: #2563eb)_
- **--dc-input-focus-ring** - Focus ring color. _(default: rgb(37 99 235 / 0.15))_
- **--dc-input-color** - Text color. _(default: #111827)_
- **--dc-input-placeholder-color** - Placeholder text color. _(default: #9ca3af)_
- **--dc-input-bg-disabled** - Background color when disabled. _(default: #f9fafb)_
- **--dc-input-radius** - Border radius. _(default: 8px)_
